notes.title: Tomorrow marks a special moment: the 20th anniversary of Trackmania Nations ESWC that started the esports journey in Trackmania.

items.text: After the announcement of Trackmania at the Esports World Cup and the Esports Nations Cup, we’re very happy to continue the celebration with a new game update tomorrow, January 27th, 2026.
Play in 4 new stunning Vistas;
Enjoy a new style of racing with the Weekly Grand Track and the Grand Enduro online race;
Progress more smoothly thanks to a new distribution of medals and an updated Prestige Skins system;
Compete in the new Cup Of The Week on campaign tracks;
Push your limits with Black Tracks to climb top ladders and qualify for the Esport World Cup and the Esports Nations Cup!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43532016/b50ccd5461d2a9525d746e2245e6e9a0543b112b.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43532016/8976a150a569ae9b290bf9643252a530f33b9b54.png"]
Read the full Update article giving you all the details.
We wish you all a wonderful year on Trackmania!
On July 1st, the 21st seasonal campaign will take you on playful and festive tracks — some of which include special celebration designs, one-off track styles, and plenty of jumps & fun!

To mark the occasion, a longer Track of the Day (TOTD) will join the festivities, along with some game updates: the introduction of a new 2v2 game mode (replacing the current 3v3), as well as several improvements to the game menus.
Also, don’t miss the Weekly Shorts campaign this Sunday — it comes with a birthday-themed twist to mark the occasion!
The game update drops at 4 PM CEST, and the campaign goes live at 5 PM CEST.
Check out the full changelog for details.
This update lays the groundwork for our next content addition, arriving with the upcoming Winter Update.

We’d like to take this opportunity to thank all of you — especially those who have been with us for many years — for your continued support and for the incredible projects you’ve created in Trackmania: from tracks, 3D items, and mods, to community events, competitions, skins, videos, and custom game modes.
Trackmania’s 5th anniversary is your celebration too — so happy anniversary to everyone!

releases.displayName: Winter update: Weekly Shorts and more!

items.text: Accessible to all players with FREE Starter Access* and fueled by community creativity, Weekly Shorts brings you back to the core of the “easy to pick up, hard to master” Trackmania experience.
Each Sunday at 6 PM CET, five new tracks will be released, allowing players to race for medals and climb both track and weekly rankings, with trophies awarded at the end of the week.

These tracks are playable in solo, online, and local multiplayer modes, with a new menu button making it easy to launch tracks directly into hotseat local multiplayer for quick games with friends on consoles with only one controller.
*Club Access players can access ALL Weekly Shorts from their launch, while Starter Access players can only enjoy the current Weekly Shorts campaign.
A dedicated Weekly Shorts Track Review is open, where creators can submit tracks for consideration. Key selection criteria include track length, readability, challenge and fun!
Additional optimizations including a refreshed User Interface, are also part of this update. You can find all the details in the changelog
For the Shorts tracks, I would like to focus on key elements and introduce the "Challenges" track type.

Trackmania's rich array of blocks, physics, and gameplay mechanics offers countless possibilities. By having over 250 Challenges annually, players will have an excellent way to explore these features. These tracks should be designed with clear physics & gameplay obstacles that will make players think & try twice, or more!
Challenges aim to bring the fun of progression and offer insights into various aspects of Trackmania's rich gameplay.
They’re also perfect for Hot Seat mode, since you can challenge your friends and experience good surprises thanks to physics or ideas.
Shorts will also bring more frequent competitive solo content alongside the Seasonnal Campaign.

We introduce the new "Top Secret" feature. Best times & ghosts will remain hidden until the end of the Weekly Shorts hunting period. This system should encourage exploration and strategy, as players might discover rare techniques to secure top rankings. Every Sunday at 6 p.m. CET, the leaderboard will lock, and the best times and ghosts will be revealed.
This “Top Secret” feature can also be applied to user-made tracks, offering players a way to keep their training strategies private until an event.
Track of the Day remains a great place for the more regular player with the best daily addition possible.

To achieve this and especially try to ensure fairness for mappers, we have introduced "like/dislike" feature to improve track ratings. This will help review servers identify those who provide good and fair ratings. ^_^
Mark your calendars for January 1st at 5 PM CET, when we release the new 25-tracks Winter campaign.
We wish you all a joyful Holiday Season, and we’ll see you in 2025! 🎉

releases.displayName: TRACKMANIA STARTER ACCESS UPDATE & NEW OFFER ANNOUNCEMENT

items.text: Dear players,
We would like to share with you an important upcoming change regarding the Trackmania offer.

While the console release has surpassed our highest expectations in terms of both amount of players and playing time, we need to adapt the quantity of content given for free with the Starter Access, to better match the way the game is played. We also have to be realistic and compare the situation with the efforts made by the studio.
As a result, we have decided that going forward, Trackmania Starter Access will give access to 10 free tracks at each new season.

Starter Access will continue to provide free access to Royal & Ranked modes (including the full tracks) and to the 10 first campaign tracks in solo and live menus. Starter Access players will also retain access to the Arcade channel, which allows them to explore and enjoy the finest creations crafted by fellow players. This will be applicable with the next Winter 2024 update.

Be sure we understand that many of you have become accustomed to playing the full campaign for free and we would have preferred to keep it that way. This adjustment is being made to ensure that we can keep on providing Starter Access users with various free content. Our primary goal is to keep Trackmania live as long as possible, and have it enjoyed by a maximum player from around the world thanks to the right balance for players who play for free and others who are making it possible for two decades.

We will also streamline the Trackmania offers by merging the content of both Standard and Club accesses into a single CLUB ACCESS offer, for an annual cost of 19.99€/$19.99. Players currently on Standard or Club accesses will maintain their status until their access expires. This will also be applicable with the next Winter 2024 update.
Finally, to better accommodate real-life constraints, we're targeting a new release date for the Winter Campaign 2024. Feel free to note in your calendar that the new date is set for January 9th.
Meanwhile, the Trackmania 20th anniversary is approaching in late November. We're looking forward to having you join us for this incredible milestone!
Ubisoft Nadeo Team.

Trackmania Spring 2023 campaign is coming on April 1st, but some game improvements are already available now in-game!

150 new blocks and items, a brand-new report system, a new morphology type choice for the pilot in the garage, new Club creation page, Royal gamemode improvements, UI upgrades and different bug fixes are available now in Trackmania!

New customization tools are available now for all players. A new morphology type choice for the pilot has been added in the garage. New players will be able to select their driver morphology at the very first game launch. Speaking of the garage, you now can combine any prestige skin with a country, club or custom skin. The new Spring 2023 Prestige skin will be available together with the seasonal campaign on April 1st at 5 PM CEST.

Different UI improvements have been deployed with this new update with a fresh Matchmaking menu design, regional Ranked leaderboard available and a new Club creation page! This new page shows preview of your medias. Great news for Royal lovers, the gamemode has been improved with the “respawn abuse” fix!

Track builders will have 150 new blocks and items to play with new alternatives with holes in blocks, deco platform curves and brand-new penalty roads! Also, more than 30 new items for multilap, start, finish and specials will allow you to create many new things! Block snapping in freemapping, icon shooting in Mesh Modeler and Z-fighting when placing ground blocks have been fixed in the track editor.

Next step is the campaign release on Saturday April 1st at 5 PM CEST with 25 brand-new tracks and the latest Prestige skin to unlock! Everything mentioned in this article will be also available from day one on the consoles and cloud platforms soon!
Full changelog available here: https://www.trackmania.com/news/7444
